description.value:
Applied by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Astral Projection]

Your consciousness is elsewhere. Your own body is unconscious and off-guard for the duration, and you perceive and speak through the astral body instead.

You may cast mental Techniques through it, using its position as the origin — the module measures range and line of effect from the astral body for those, and from your own body for everything else.

Damage to your body ends this effect and leaves you stunned 1.
